observations: Disposal follows durable score, packet, trace, assessment, and reconstruction records.
The saved score and runtime attestation must agree before disposal.
Path, owner, device, inode, and symbolic-link checks protect the two private trial copies.
Current file and Git metadata fingerprints detect later edits, ignored files, and configuration changes.
The immutable-image probe checks commits, branch states, and clean worktrees with read-only mounts and no network or credentials.
Incomplete, changed, unattested, and unverifiable copies remain intact.
Descriptor-relative removal preserves the source cache and external files.
Continuation retains completed scores and exact disposal proofs without new model work.
All twelve actual diagnostic captures give specific recovery actions at both widths and color modes.
limits: The Docker probe uses a disposable Git fixture and invokes no model.
The focused lifecycle checks use controlled runtime fixtures.
The independent sandbox cannot execute the separate command-server socket check; the parent host suite covers it.
The historical live model integration predates this disposal change.
